scenario.name: 芳右島ドリル(芳島ドリル)

segments.text: Amu Uzuki is an adolescent entertainer, actress and celebrity, widely known and recognized across Japan for her acting, affluence, and looks. She visits Kouka Academy in response to the play being arranged and offers to participate in it; taking a fondness for Yoshijirou. In spite of the fame and fortune she commands, her classist family, constant traveling, few friends and nonexistent love life take a toll on her.
From Wikipedia.
【出席番号22 / 芸能人】
天才子役の呼び声も高い芸能人。
芸能活動を中心に行ってきたが、突然、休養宣言を発表。
学園に通い出すがそこでも芸能人という特殊な目で見られがち。
常に演じることを余儀なくされているため、誰かに本当の自分を見てほしいと思っている。
「みんな、私の事、芸能人としてしか見てないの」
天才子役の呼び声も高い芸能人。
芸能活動を中心に行ってきたが、突然、休養宣言を発表。学校に通い出すがそこでも芸能人という特殊な目で見られがち。常に演じることを余儀なくされているため、誰かに本当の自分を見てほしいと思っている。2年B組の演劇発表では、大道具を担当。
「みんな、私の事、芸能人としてしか見てないの」

Distant and reserved, Sora Suzuhara is a second-year student who is also on the swim team. With a preference for solitude and disinterest in others, Sora is antisocial, nihilistic, mysterious, and deadpan. Through her acquaintance with Yoshijirou however, Sora becomes emotional, open and appreciative.
From Wikipedia.
【出席番号28 / 水泳部】
虚無的で何事に対しても冷めた雰囲気、他人に合わせようという意思がなく、好んで独りでいることが多い。
冷静に現実を見つめる目には、フィクションの類は受け入れられないようで、どこか蔑んでいる様子。
「漫画なんて、子供の読むものでしょ。バカバカしい」
水泳部の選手候補。
虚無的で何事に対しても冷めた雰囲気、他人に合わせようという意思がなく、好んで独りでいることが多い。冷静に現実を見つめる目には、フィクションの類は受け入れられないようで、どこか蔑んでいる様子。ある事件をきっかけに、密かに主人公に想いを寄せている。2年B組の演劇発表では、役者を担当。
「漫画なんて、子供の読むものでしょ。バカバカしい」

Loud and headstrong, Mirai Aoi is a second-year student and the most iconic character of the series. Known among her class by the nickname "Captain", Mirai is a temperamental, fastidious leader, determined to combat the ridicule and undermining she and her group regularly receive from the rest of the school. An accomplice by association, Mirai is required to assist Yoshijirou in appropriating their class for the play; a task she grows to respect and admire him for.
From Wikipedia.
【出席番号21/ 元演劇部】
2年B組の参謀的な役割を務め、「キャプテン」と呼ばれ恐れられる危険な女の子。
演劇部に所属していたが、色々とあって退部している。
演劇部との演劇勝負に勝利するために、悪知恵と呼ばれる類の才能を駆使して2年B組を扇動する。
「バカ！　ほんと、バカ!!　何にも分かってない！」
2年B組の参謀的な役割を務め、「キャプテン」と呼ばれ恐れられる危険な女の子。
演劇部に所属していたが、顧問とのいざこざが原因で除名された。演劇部との演劇勝負に勝利するために、悪知恵と呼ばれる類の才能を駆使して2年B組を扇動する。主人公の事が気になるらしく、何かと世話を焼く。2年B組の演劇発表では、脚本を担当している。
「バカ！　ほんと、バカ！！　何にも分かってない！」

Momiji Aio is a second-year student, recognizable by her long pink hair and flamboyant wardrobe; aspiring to be a playwright and director. A short, friendly girl, Momiji is meek and easily intimidated by nature; on stage, a serious and capable actress. She is good friends with Mirai.
From Wikipedia.
【出席番号20/ 演劇部】
天才演劇少女だが、その才能に気付いているのは未来と愛善部長のみ。
愛善部長が彼女の演技力に嫉妬して役を与えないので、衣装係をしている。
不遇な扱いを受けているが、前向きで明るい（天然ボケ）ので、その状況に気付いていない。
「リュックの中は、ネコさんのごはんで、いっぱいです」
演劇部所属の天才演劇少女。
しかし、自分の才能に気付かず衣装係をしている。演劇部の部長は彼女の才能に気付いているが、もみじの演技力に嫉妬して役を与えない。不遇な扱いを受けているのだが、前向きな明るい少女（天然ボケ）なので、自分の置かれた状況に気付いていないようだ。主人公のことが苦手なのだが、未来の為にそれを表に出さないよう努力している。2年B組の演劇発表では、衣装係を担当している。
「リュックの中は、ネコさんのごはんで、いっぱいです」

Direct and quiet, Motoko Sakimori is a second-year student who doubles as the local Shinto shrine maiden. She is recognized for donning her robes in place of a school uniform, serious, tough-love attitude, nage-waza martial arts and purple hair. In a fashion similar to Sora, Motoko opens up around Yoshijirou, showing a less seen, tender side of her; one including an affection for anything cute.
From Wikipedia.
【出席番号25 / 合気道部】
神社の娘で、延々と受け継がれている古武術の担い手。
心技体を完璧に会得し、毅然とした立居振舞いで、融通が利かない程に真面目。
だが実は、可愛いものに目がない一面も。
「男子は苦手・・・女の子の方がいい・・・・」
合気道部所属。神社の娘で、延々と受け継がれている古武術の担い手。
心技体を完璧に会得し、毅然とした立居振舞いで、融通が利かない程に真面目。実は可愛いものに目がなく、可愛い女の子にも目がない。そのため主人公のことなど眼中になさげ。2年B組の演劇発表では、役者を担当。
「男子は苦手・・・女の子の方がいい・・・・」

Youko Momoi is a second-year student who is on the girl's softball team as an ace pitcher. A friendly though clumsy girl, Youko is easily intimidated, buckles under pressure and struggles with theatre. Of all the characters that appear in the game, Youko is the only one bespectacled female.
From Wikipedia.
【出席番号36/ ソフトボール部】
ソフトボール部のエースピッチャー。
だが、極度のアガリ症で凄まじくプレッシャーに弱い。
過去に演劇の経験があり、どうやら、その時のことがトラウマになっているようなのだが…。
「わ、わゎ、私、だめなんですぅぅぅぅ～～～～～～!!」
ソフトボール部のエースピッチャー。
だが、極度のアガリ症で凄まじくプレッシャーに弱い。過去に演劇の経験があり、どうやら、その時のことがトラウマになっているようなのだが・・・・。主人公を怖がって避けている。2年B組の演劇発表では、大道具を担当。
「わ、わゎ、私、だめなんですぅぅぅぅ～～～～～～！！」
A mysterious member of class 2-B.
His real identity is Hebime Itaru (蛇目 至) without his long wig.
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Mirin is a member of the school's Softball team.

Mirin is a cute and beautiful girl who has lots of practice in seducing males. She generally behaves like a hostess because both of her parents were hosts. She always laughs about gaining her practice with her teachers (and she almost tricked one of her principals) through elementary school and junior high school; and now, as a high-school student, she has begun to bloom a talent in this "skill".
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Makoto is a member of the school's Athletics club.

She is always full of energy, and because of that she is a very fast runner. Makoto often behaves foolishly, people even say that she has a loose screw in her head, which is seems to be stuck in another part of her body...
Makoto also tends to call people nicknames without permission. Generally, Makoto is 2-B's trouble-maker; she's always busy with annoying and taunting people.
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Maki is a member of the school's Arts and Crafts club.

She is so calm and unfussy, it takes her three times the time it takes a normal human to react to anything. Due to this, she is immune to anything. If something bad happens she is smiling sincerely, healing mentally the people around her.

There are no human beings who have ever seen her face of astonishment, impatience, or horror. However, she can cry, even when she is impressed by little things. This helps people to approach her more easily.
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Hijiri is a member of the school's Library committee.
She is weak at communicating with others, or talking to people in general. It seems she does not know how to deal with this, and she thinks she is not liked because of this.
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Chika looks and behaves like a kild, so she is treated like the whole classes' younger sister.
She likes animals, she bought a few animals she is now caring for.
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Minori is a member of the school's Athletics club.

Her brain - ordinary. Her appearance - normal. Her aura - sober. She spends every day of her life very ordinary, she even seems to be depressed about this. But! people say that her running pace is extraordinary fast.
Another member of class 2-B.
Konoha is a member of the school's Library committee.

She is a susceptible girl who fell in love with Sakimori Motoko, her senpai whom she longs for. Konoha is always worrying if senpai loves her or not. She lovingly wears the amulet that she got from her senpai.
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Momo is a member of the school's Drama club.
Because she was the first on some secret ranking list, she is being hated by everyone in the class.
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Akira is a member of the school's Basketball team (Forward position).

Although she looks and dresses like a boy, Akira is just a girl who is devoted to basketball. Akira relies mostly on her own power to win the game. She does not try to see too much around her strong tendency of this.
She is getting overwhelming support from younger girls, and she thinks it's cool.
Lifestyle guidance teacher.
Newspaper club member.
Newspaper club member.
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Takeo is a member of the school's Astronomy club.
Takeo is the owner of a strong and overwhelming presence that makes everybody respect him at first sight. He almost never talks, and it has been rumored that he's is fond of cats.
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Getarou is a member of the school's Drama club. He is often bullied by the strangest members of the same club.
Another member of class 2-B.
Tarou is a very loyal member of the school's Baseball team.
Another strange member of class 2-B.
He is a member of the Anime and Manga Research Society, and as a part of it, he is a genuine anime and manga geek.
Does not even try to listen to the opinions of other people, it is often said that while he speaks, he no longer notices anyone around him.
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Koishi is a stupid, baseball crazy 4th batter of the school's Baseball team. He always carries a Baseball bat with him.

Oosugi is the vice principal of the school and the adviser of the Drama club. Thanks to him the Drama Club has gained a reputation of a prestigious, highly influential club, but almost only in the eyes of the school's teachers and head staff.
An extremely weird-looking tall and slim guy (or alien?). He's a member of the school's Drama club and a bully.
A weird-looking chubby guy. He's a member of the school's Drama club and a bully.
A weird-looking short guy. He's a member of the school's Drama club and a bully.

A sadistic redhead with glasses. He is very interested in the spunky Mirai and wants her to be his sex toy, but Mirai wants nothing to do with him. He and Yumeko find Yoshijirou beating up the students in a line of defense and decides his and the Class 2-B's punishment.
Edited from MAL.
Another member of class 2-B.
Kiminobu is a member of the school's Newspaper club.

Kiminobu loves people and trusts them blindly, which makes him easily exploitable. Since he is also not very good at thinking, he believes people unconditionally, people can even make him commit outrageous crimes without knowing it. Besides that, he's friendly and gentle to others.
Another strange member of class 2-B.

Kochi is a member of the school's Basketball team. Even though he has a a foul mouth and can burst out of rage at some times, he can easily make friends with just anyone. so it makes him particularly angry when someone speaks ill of his mother, he even can start a fight because of this. His violet behavior is generally disapproved by the teachers.
Another strange member of class 2-B.

Itaru is a a wannabe heavy metal star guitarist who dreams about touring the world with his concerts. He likes to play very loud rock and metal music. Although he's very daunting, he would not hesitate to rely on "Big Brother" Yoshijirou and cooperate with him, because he felt that he is a worthy rock musician opponent.
Actually, Itaru is a very handsome guy with green eyes. He hides his true appearance under a long wig in order to look like a rocker.
The school's nurse.
Kiato is a third-year high school student and the president of the school's Newspaper club.

Kiato is a very unique student and he usually has facial expressions that resemble kaomojis. He also has a speech quirk to accompany said expressions and he even says and imitates popular Japanese sound effects like 'yaka~an' or 'shobon..' when he speaks. He appears to be interested in popular students like Amu and Motoko. He has a possible crush on Motoko and always asks her if he's allowed to take pictures of her, which she declines, but he doesn't seem to listen as he persists and gets beat up and thrown around by her quite a lot.

Kiato also gets really angry if people touch things in the newspaper club room without his permission, especially if they're not a member of the club. This is best shown when he threatens Yoshijirou after he tries to pick up a camera from the table in the room, to which Kiato reacts immediately, becoming aggressive and telling Yoshijirou to never do that again unless he wants things to get very bad.

Further events in the visual novel also show him to be spiteful and he's shown to be a huge revenge seeker, as he gets mad about Motoko rejecting him and lures her at the back of the school waiting with two of his club members. However Yoshijirou finds out about this and goes to the spot, engaging into a fight. Kiato manages to spray Motoko in the eyes with pepper spray and blinds her temporarily. When he realizes his plan has failed, he apologizes insincerely and tells Motoko and Yoshijirou to help him with things in the sports shed, however that turns out to be a lie as he locks both of them in the shed once they walk in and then makes fun of them for being hard-headed and believing him.
His real face is rarely seen as most of his expressions are kaomojis, but when his true face is out there, it means he's up to mischief.
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Junichi is a member of the school's Soccer team.
Another strange member of class 2-B.
He's a member of the school's Drama club.
Another strange member of class 2-B.

Atsushi is a part of the school's Department of Fine Arts. He is a cool and fine looking guy, who speaks slowly and relaxed. Nobody knows what is on his mind most of the time. He seems to have no interest in the outside world, for he is busy focusing on his own.

Yoshijirou Saku is the unlikely protagonist of the series. A recent second-year transfer student, his life takes an unexpected turn when he is blamed for fighting and threatened with expulsion, along with fellow classmate Mirai Aoi. Given the chance to redress his actions, Yoshijirou is assigned to recruit his entire class, a notorious group of disobedient misfits, to perform in a play lest having to leave school permanently with them.
From Wikipedia.

Kanako became the homeroom teacher of class 2-B, after their previous homeroom teacher was hospitalized into a mental institution as a result of dealing with this crazy class. Also, this is her first job as a teacher.
She enchants her male students with her large breasts and with innocent, but mature charm without realizing it.
Kanako treats Yoshijirou as if he was her younger brother, and she also takes Yoshijirou's side on the competition.
Another strange member of class 2-B.

Kanata is the Student council's secretary. She was elected to this position as a joke, thanks to her name, which is easy to remember. Her main job is to take handwritten notes of every convention they're having on the student's council. Even though Tanaka-san gained this position not because of respect, she takes her job very seriously. She even practices her writing every night at home. She has gained an obsession to writing fonts due to this, but it seem that her favourite font is Mincho.
Yato is a member of the school's Softball team, and she attends class 2-B.

Yato has been known for her big breasts since elementary school, it seems they've been growing since then without any sign to stop. She has a big complex about this, she even tries all sorts of methods to reduce their growth. Yato tries to avoid boys most of the time, since boys are constantly looking at her because of this trait of hers.
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Nyoriko is a member of the school's Astronomy club.

She claims to be an alien from Planet Nyori, which is located in a stellar system that exists in a distant galaxy light years away from the solar system. Nyoriko left her mother on planet Nyori, so she feels lonely on the earth, even though she made lots of friends far away from home.
Shinobu is a member of the school's Swimming club. She sees Suzuhara Sora as her rival and enemy because she can't keep up with her swimming speed.
Another strange member of class 2-B.

She's a (almost never present, even a ghost-like) member of the school's Drama club. Yumi has the atmosphere and the looks of a mature woman. She is also very picky about the people she socializes with. She can even be violent if she dislikes the person she is taking with.
Another strange member of class 2-B.
Nayuta is a member of the school's Aikido club.
Nayuta is often bullied for looking like a little girl. He's pretty paranoid because of that.
She's the vice president of the school's Drama club, and the current lover and ally of the club's president, Aizen Yukihito.
Yumeko is a standard ojou-sama, who only bends under the will of Yukihito.
Anekouji-san is Uzuki Amu's manager.
